title: $L^p$-weighted cone restriction estimates
summary: We study Fourier extension estimates for the truncated cone in $\R^{n+1}$ with weights satisfying an $m$-dimensional ball condition only at radii between $1$ and $R^{1/2}$, where $0<m\le n-1$. Within the discrete induction framework of Du--Li--Wang--Zhang, we obtain a family of bounds by combining multilinear refined Strichartz inequalities, narrow decoupling, and Lorentz rescaling. We also give lightplank, lattice, and hybrid lattice--Knapp examples.
